reason: The only offered combination appears to start the cloud's contraction toward a young Sun.

effect: The cloud is contracting under gravity while retaining its inherited dust and ice; rotation is the next available ingredient.
reaction: The connection to the earlier ice and dust is satisfying.
reason: The only offered combination brings rotation into the collapse, likely advancing toward a disk.
expectation: I expect the rotating filament to flatten or form a rotating structure, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The collapsing core rotates, so infalling material cannot all travel straight into the star; the next choice may develop either the gas or dust side.
reaction: The link between rotation and the eventual disk is clear.
reason: Combining the core with the molecular cloud seems a direct way to build the young star from infalling gas.
expectation: I expect further collapse or a developing protostar, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Ice-mantled dust might advance the disk, but I want to follow the collapsing gas first.

effect: The collapsing core has produced a shining protostar; the disk remains to be made.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the cloud become the young Sun.
reason: Combining the rotating core with icy dust looks like the most direct route toward the remaining disk goal.
expectation: I expect a rotating dust structure or an early disk, though its exact form is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Hydrogen might advance the protostar, but I want to follow the disk formation first.

effect: The rotating core and icy dust formed the planet-forming disk, completing one goal; the young Sun's light remains.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the inherited dust and ice become part of a disk.
reason: Hydrogen may advance the protostar toward becoming a young star and completing the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect the protostar to develop toward sustained hydrogen fusion, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The magnetic field may also affect the protostar, but its connection to the light goal is less clear to me.

effect: The young Sun shines from contraction and accretion before sustained hydrogen burning, so my fusion expectation was premature.
reaction: That distinction was useful and a little surprising.
reason: Combining the young Sun with its disk seems likely to let its light reach its surroundings.
expectation: I expect the young Sun to illuminate or warm the surrounding disk, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Escaping radiation might also advance the light goal, but the disk seems a more direct surrounding target.

effect: The young Sun and disk formed a hot inner region, but the light goal remains open.
reaction: The temperature difference helps explain how distance affects which materials stay solid.
reason: Escaping radiation is the only offered combination and may advance the remaining light goal.
expectation: I expect the young Sun's radiation to escape and illuminate its surroundings, though the exact result is uncertain.

effect: The young Sun's radiation became sunlight, completing the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: The distinction between this sunlight and the earlier massive star's light is a useful clarification.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hot inner disk was worthwhile: it connected heating and distance to which materials can remain solid.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making sunlight felt somewhat repetitive after the protostar had already begun to shine; the separate light goal was not entirely clear.

surprise.text: I expected progress toward hydrogen fusion, but learned that contraction and accretion power the young Sun before sustained main-sequence burning.

arbitrary.text: Combining the young Sun with escaping radiation to make sunlight felt a little abstract, especially since it was already shining, though its purpose was clear from the goal.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the disk's temperature differences shape the formation of worlds; that connection made the next stage interesting.
